## Day 1 — Central Oxford

A compact loop through central Oxford's academic core: an exterior view
of the Radcliffe Camera before it gets busy, into the Bodleian's guided
tour, then Christ Church's college and cathedral, a lunch break at the
Covered Market, and closing at the Ashmolean — Oxford's free,
less-crowded afternoon museum option. Kept to four formal stops so the
Bodleian's guided-tour slot doesn't compress the rest of the day.

**Estimated walk:** 4.5 km · **Intensity:** moderate
